extracted.intended_audience: UC Berkeley campus communicators (faculty, staff, students, alumni) and external media partners seeking guidance on strategic communications and use of university communications resources
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance from UC Berkeley Strategic Communications on how to craft and deliver institutional messaging that inspires audiences, elevates the university's image, and leverages official channels, brand assets, and communications disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tell the UC Berkeley story to inspire audiences and elevate the image
rubrics_metrics.description: Telling the story of how UC Berkeley changes the world. Strategic Communications tells the UC Berkeley story to inspire audiences and elevate the image of the university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary goal of all communications is to inspire target audiences and enhance the university's reputation by highlighting how Berkeley 'changes the world.' Messaging should be framed with that purpose in mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver clear, cohesive, and strategically aligned communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver clear, cohesive, and strategically aligned communications that elevate the university’s voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should be consistent (cohesive), easy to understand (clear), and aligned with strategic objectives and the university brand. The Strategic Communications teams bring cross-discipline expertise (internal communications, marketing & brand, news & media relations, strategic & critical communications, social media, video, web) to achieve this.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner closely with campus audiences and external media
rubrics_metrics.description: We partner closely with various campus audiences — from the chancellor, deans and faculty members, to staff, students and alumni — as well as external media organizations who can amplify UC Berkeley’s important contributions across a wide range of subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective work requires collaboration with internal stakeholders (leadership, faculty, staff, students, alumni) and proactive engagement with external media to amplify stories. Identify and coordinate with appropriate campus contacts and media partners as part of communications planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use specialized resources and services to strengthen brand and outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic Communications provides a variety of specialized resources and services designed to strengthen the university’s brand and outreach, including media and news services, brand and creative resources, tools and guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage the office's services (media/news support, creative/brand resources, tools and guidelines) to ensure professional, on-brand, and effective outreach rather than creating ad hoc materials without consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage official channels and assets (Berkeley News, Berkeley Brand, newsletter, events, email, photo library, communicators group)
rubrics_metrics.description: Major resources include: Berkeley News (main news and information website); Berkeley Brand (official guidelines and assets); The Berkeleyan (weekly email newsletter); Berkeley Events (official calendar system); Calmessages (official email messaging system); Photo Gallery (official digital media library); Berkeley Communicators Group (community for campus communicators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the official channels and assets listed to distribute and amplify content, follow brand guidelines and asset usage rules, submit events to the official calendar, use Calmessages for official campus emails, and join the Berkeley Communicators Group to share best practices. These resources are intended to increase reach and maintain brand consistency.
